existing_otel.source_snapshot:
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
provider = TracerProvider()
trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
tracer = trace.get_tracer("existing_agent")
async def model_call(messages, client):
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("chat local-demo", attributes={"gen_ai.operation.name": "chat", "gen_ai.provider.name": "ollama", "gen_ai.request.model": "local-demo"}):
        return await client.chat(messages=messages, temperature=0.2, stream=True)
async def tool_call(arguments, handler):
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("execute_tool lookup_weather", attributes={"gen_ai.operation.name": "execute_tool", "gen_ai.tool.name": "lookup_weather"}):
        return await handler(arguments)
existing_otel.content_hooks: Actual messages/arguments and returned values are available at the same producer boundary
